description: This file defines a Zoom video API adapter with functions to create, update, delete, and fetch availability of Zoom meetings, including handling of user settings, recurrence, and password validation.

methods.name: hasInvalidConsecutiveChars
methods.description: Checks if a password contains invalid sequences such as keyboard sequences, repetitive, ascending, or descending characters.

methods.name: validatePasswordAgainstRequirements
methods.description: Validates a password against specified password requirements including length, character types, and sequences.

methods.name: getCompliantPassword
methods.description: Returns a password that complies with the given password requirements, or undefined if none is found.
